examples: Install Carnivore, open it on the same computer, scan the code with your authenticator app, and type one code to finish.
Join a second computer to your pack: choose join your pack on its first-run screen and type the code from your main computer; it links to the pack without an authenticator of its own.
how_to: Open Carnivore on the computer it runs on (the menu bar opens it on first launch, or use Finish Setup... in the menu). Choose set up as a new computer, or join your pack.
Scan the code with any authenticator app, or open can't scan? and type the key.
Choose i scanned it, type the 6-digit code from the app, and choose finish setup.
The window opens Terminal for the join; if it cannot, it shows a line to paste there.
media_exempt: needs an unpaired test slot and scripts/testsrv always writes the pairing sentinel; follow-up issue #1535
name: First-run setup
summary: an unpaired install shows a carnivore setup screen only on the computer it runs on: set up a new authenticator, or join your pack with a code from your main computer.
where: On the computer Carnivore runs on, open Carnivore before pairing an authenticator: the setup screen replaces the login screen.
From any other device before pairing: a panel says to finish setup on the computer.
